pageBootstrapContext.note: Probe-page hydration long tasks, outside the certified runtime. Recorded so a reader can reconcile the raw trace (e.g. a ~52 ms cold-hydration task) with the certified runtime-phase result.
pageBootstrapContext.boundaryDefinition: runtime phase begins at the runtime's first requestAnimationFrame request (React hydration never schedules rAF); a long task counts as runtime when start+duration >= boundary, so runtime init/first-frame is included and only tasks that fully completed before the runtime came up are excluded
